_: The gateway's floors, bottom up (docs/ARCHITECTURE.md, «Этажи»; docs/plans/modular-gateway.md). A module of gateway/src may use its own floor and those below; scripts/check-layers.mjs (CI) fails on a link up a floor that is not in "exceptions". Since 24.11.2026 there are none (step 6 of the plan): what a module needs from a floor above comes down as a word, a small trait or a hook. A line added on purpose says why in its commit; a line no longer needed fails too (--update strikes it off). `lib`: the crate root's own items (VERSION).
